subject: general
question: The length of a rectangular sheet is 15.2 cm ± 0.1 cm and the width is 9.11 cm ± 0.1 * cm / 1, then what is the error in estimating the area of ​​the rectangular sheet?
solution:
__**Concept:**__

The error in the area of a rectangle is calculated using the formula for **propagation of errors**:

 Delta A = w Delta L + L Delta W 

Where:

__
 
• L = 15.2 pm 0.1 {cm}
 
• W = 9.11 pm 0.1 {cm}
 
• Delta L = Delta W = 0.1 {cm} 

**Calculation:**__

 Delta A = (9.11 times 0.1) + (15.2 times 0.1) 

 Delta A = 0.911 + 1.52 = 2.431 {cm}² 

Approximately:

 Delta A approx 2 {cm}²
